SELECT lu2.id AS userId, lu2.user_name AS userName, lu2.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu2.account AS userAccount FROM login_user lu JOIN user_friend uf ON (uf.user_id = lu.id OR uf.friend_id = lu.id) JOIN login_user lu2 ON ( (uf.user_id = lu.id AND uf.friend_id = lu2.id) OR (uf.friend_id = lu.id AND uf.user_id = lu2.id) ) WHERE lu.account = #{userAccount}

SELECT lu2.id AS userId, lu2.user_name AS userName, lu2.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu2.account AS userAccount FROM login_user lu JOIN user_friend uf ON (uf.user_id = lu.id OR uf.friend_id = lu.id) JOIN login_user lu2 ON ( (uf.user_id = lu.id AND uf.friend_id = lu2.id) OR (uf.friend_id = lu.id AND uf.user_id = lu2.id) ) WHERE lu.id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.friend_id ELSE uf.user_id END AS userId, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.user_name ELSE luu.user_name END AS userName, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.avatar_file_id ELSE luu.avatar_file_id END AS avatarFileId, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.account ELSE luu.account END AS userAccount, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.remark_user_for_friend -- 作为user, remark_user_for_friend是他备注别人 ELSE uf.remark_friend_for_user -- 作为friend, remark_friend_for_user是他备注别人 END AS remark FROM user_friend uf JOIN login_user luu ON uf.user_id = luu.id JOIN login_user luf ON uf.friend_id = luf.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} OR uf.friend_id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.friend_id ELSE uf.user_id END AS userId, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.user_name ELSE luu.user_name END AS userName, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.avatar_file_id ELSE luu.avatar_file_id END AS avatarFileId, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN luf.account ELSE luu.account END AS userAccount, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.remark_user_for_friend ELSE uf.remark_friend_for_user END AS remark FROM user_friend uf JOIN login_user luu ON uf.user_id = luu.id JOIN login_user luf ON uf.friend_id = luf.id WHERE (uf.user_id = #{userId} OR uf.friend_id = #{userId}) AND (uf.friend_id = #{friendId} OR uf.user_id = #{friendId})
